_comment: Hand-written, fictional supplement for the screenshot mock. Nothing here is copied from a real posting, company or note. Source names are generic format enums; links resolve to example.invalid. Posting text stays English.

jobs.title: Junior Full-Stack Developer
jobs.teaser: Build customer-facing booking tools with a friendly product team.
jobs.description: Marlowe Bay Software is a fictional company. You will work across a React and TypeScript front end and a Python back end on PostgreSQL, ship through Jenkins pipelines, and run services in Docker on AWS. We review every change in Git and pair often. This is a junior seat: you will be mentored by two senior engineers and learn how we test, deploy and monitor. Experience with SQL is helpful. Hybrid with three office days in Melbourne. Applicants must hold full work rights in Australia.

jobs.title: Junior Full-Stack Developer
jobs.description: Cross-listed copy of the Marlowe Bay junior role. React, TypeScript, Python, PostgreSQL, Docker. Mentoring provided.

jobs.title: Graduate Data Engineer
jobs.teaser: Move data from messy sources into reliable reporting tables.
jobs.description: Glasswing Analytics is fictional. As a graduate data engineer you will write SQL and Python jobs, schedule them, and document each table. You will learn Terraform for our AWS infrastructure and use Git daily. Graduates rotate through reporting, platform and quality teams during the first year. No prior commercial experience is required.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer (NV1 Required)
jobs.description: Eastgate Defence is fictional. You will maintain Linux build servers and Ansible playbooks for a secure development network. This position requires an active NV1 clearance before commencement; we cannot sponsor candidates who do not already hold one.

jobs.title: Software Developer - Government Programs
jobs.teaser: Deliver services for a fictional state agency.
jobs.description: Northfield Digital is fictional. You will build Java and Spring Boot services with PostgreSQL for a state agency program. Due to contract terms, Australian citizens only will be considered for this role. Git, Jenkins and Docker are used throughout.

jobs.title: Junior Data Analyst
jobs.teaser: Turn claims data into weekly dashboards.
jobs.description: Birchwood Insurance Services is fictional. Candidates should be Australian citizens or permanent residents because the role handles regulated customer records. You will write SQL, build Tableau dashboards and document the numbers for the claims team. Python is a bonus.

jobs.title: Senior Principal Lead Cloud Platform Reliability and Observability Engineering Manager (Hybrid - Melbourne CBD or Remote within Australia, Multiple Openings)
jobs.company: Stonecrop Infrastructure Holdings Group Pty Ltd
jobs.teaser: A deliberately long title to check wrapping on narrow screens.
jobs.description: Stonecrop Infrastructure Holdings is fictional. This long-titled posting exists to check layout. You will lead platform teams running Kubernetes and Terraform on AWS and set reliability targets. You bring at least 8 years of experience in infrastructure engineering and people leadership.

jobs.title: Mobile Developer (Graduate)
jobs.description: Pinecone Lane Apps is fictional. Graduates will help build JavaScript and TypeScript features for a cross-platform shopping app, write tests and review code in Git. Training provided; no salary is listed on the advertisement.

jobs.title: Service Desk Analyst
jobs.teaser: Front-line support for a regional office.
jobs.description: Ridgeway Council Services is fictional. Provide first-line support for Windows laptops and Active Directory accounts, log tickets and escalate when needed. Part time, three days a week.

jobs.title: Release Engineer
jobs.description: Tallowwood Software is fictional. Own the release pipeline: Jenkins, Docker and Kubernetes on AWS, with Terraform for environments and Python scripts to glue it together. You will need at least 3 years of experience running production releases.

jobs.title: Release Engineer
jobs.description: Duplicate listing of the Tallowwood release engineer role, posted again after an edit.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Intern
jobs.teaser: Learn manual and automated testing on an education product.
jobs.description: Fernbank Learning is fictional. Interns write test cases, run Selenium checks in Python and report bugs. A driver's licence is preferred for occasional site visits.

jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer - Linux
jobs.teaser: Keep a small hosting estate healthy.
jobs.description: Quartz Hollow Hosting is fictional. Look after Linux servers, write Ansible roles and keep monitoring tidy. On-call roster shared across the team. Based in Perth; relocation is not offered.

jobs.title: Cloud Support Associate
jobs.teaser: Help customers get unstuck on AWS.
jobs.description: Lantern Reef Cloud is fictional. You will answer customer tickets about AWS accounts, Docker images and Linux basics, and write short help articles. Associates get a structured six-month training plan.
